test_title: PYST 32 - SSC CHSL 2025 - English Language (Held On: 24 Nov, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect voice.

"The workers will be installing the new equipment," the supervisor said.

options.text: The supervisor said that the workers would be installing the new equipment.
The supervisor said that the workers will be installing the new equipment.
The supervisor said that the workers had been installing the new equipment.
The supervisor said that the workers were installing the new equipment.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Reporting Verb:** The reporting verb **"said"** remains unchanged as there is no specific object (listener) mentioned.
 
• **Conjunction:** The comma and inverted commas are removed, and the conjunction **"that"** is added to introduce the reported speech.
 
• **Tense Change:** When the reporting verb is in the past tense ("said"), the future continuous tense **"will be installing"** must be changed to its past equivalent, **"would be installing"**.
 
• **Sentence Structure:** The rest of the sentence ("the workers" and "the new equipment") remains the same as there are no pronouns or time expressions that require shifting in this specific context.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The supervisor said that the workers would be installing the new equipment."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2:** Incorrect because it fails to backshift the modal **"will"** to **"would"**.
 
• **Option 3:** Incorrect because it changes the tense to **Past Perfect Continuous** ("had been installing"), which would only be correct if the direct speech was in the Present Perfect Continuous or Past Continuous.
 
• **Option 4:** Incorrect because it changes the tense to **Past Continuous** ("were installing"), which alters the original future-focused meaning of the supervisor's statement.
